description.value: Mnimes Restaurant & Bar is a Greek restaurant on Victoria Drive in Vancouver's south end, founded by Chef Manos, a classically trained culinary instructor from Athens whose Vancouver résumé includes executive roles at several well-known Greek establishments. The menu emphasizes authenticity, drawing on locally sourced ingredients and imports from Greece for dishes ranging from grilled octopus and lamb chops to moussaka and loukoumades. The restaurant has received recognition through the Greek Taste Beyond Borders program and the Canadian Choice Awards.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully and provides strong primary evidence. OSM and website agree on phone (778-980-8880) and address (6459 Victoria Drive, Vancouver, V5P 3X5); the website FAQ and menu corroborate vegetarian/vegan options (also in OSM diet tags) and the navigation confirms online ordering. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Mnimes Restaurant' but the website consistently uses 'Mnimes Restaurant Bar' and 'Mnimes Restaurant & Bar By Chef Manos' — the OSM entry appears to be missing 'Bar'.
Hours discrepancy: OSM tags show Monday open and Wednesday closed, while the website FAQ shows Monday closed and Wednesday open — one source is outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate full-service Greek restaurant with confirmed contact details, online ordering, and clear vegetarian/vegan options — a worthwhile Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists on the Victoria Drive corridor. Bike parking status is unknown but does not disqualify the listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website FAQ states 'Yes! We have both vegetarian and vegan options marked by VEG for vegetarian and V for vegan.' Multiple veg/vegan items are marked throughout the menu. No gluten-free mention found

wow_evidence: received recognition through the Greek Taste Beyond Borders program and the Canadian Choice Awards

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Named executive chef, prix-fixe 3-course menu, appetizer prices $15-23
